entities.name: Moritte of the Frost
entities.description: A shapeshifter from Littjara on Kaldheim, born a Gladewalker, who took the form of a young Covewalker to learn their secrets.

entities.name: Littjara
entities.description: Home of the shapeshifters on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Covewalkers
entities.description: Shapeshifters among whom Moritte lived to absorb their knowledge.

entities.name: Gladewalkers
entities.description: Shapeshifter group Moritte was born into.

events.summary: Moritte took the form of a young Covewalker and absorbed their knowledge and secrets.
events.quote: Moritte absorbed all their knowledge and secrets before vanishing into the mists

events.summary: Moritte vanished into the mists and now wanders the realms seeking answers.
